# E0606: two packages with one name

A package's modules are named after it, so a program can't hold two packages of one name. Remove one of them.

- Rule: [`packages.one-name-one-package`](../../reference/04-programs.md#packages.one-name-one-package)
- Reported at: the first entry of the root's manifest that, with the entries before it, brings both packages.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0606_two_packages_one_name`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0606_two_packages_one_name):

`deps/http/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
pub fn get() -> i64 { 1 }
```

`deps/http/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "http"

[dependencies]
json = { path = "vendor/json" }
```

`deps/http/vendor/json/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
pub fn parse(s: str) -> i64 { 2 }
```

`deps/http/vendor/json/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "json"
```

`deps/json/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
pub fn parse(s: str) -> i64 { 1 }
```

`deps/json/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "json"
```

`src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
fn main() / io { print("app") }
```

`stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "app"

[dependencies]
json = { path = "deps/json" }
http = { path = "deps/http" }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── TWO PACKAGES WITH ONE NAME ────────────────────────── stilt.toml:6:1  [E0606]

This entry brings a second package `json`, in deps/http/vendor/json, beside the
one in deps/json:

  6 │ http = { path = "deps/http" }
    │ ^^^^

A package's modules are named after it, so a program can't hold two packages of
one name. Remove one of them.
```
